# The Indian Express

> > India's leading English-language news platform covering national news, sports, lifestyle, and cultural events with comprehensive coverage of Indian festivals, cricket tournaments, and trending topics.

The Indian Express provides authoritative journalism on Indian current affairs, sports including IPL cricket, lifestyle content, and detailed coverage of Hindu festivals and cultural celebrations. The platform serves as a comprehensive resource for news, analysis, and information relevant to Indian audiences and the global Indian diaspora.

## Key Topics

- Holi and Hindu Festivals
- Holika Dahan
- IPL Cricket
- Indian Calendar and Muhurat Times
- Rangwali Holi
- Drik Panchang
- Festival of Colors
- Lord Krishna and Hindu Mythology
- Indian Sports Standings
- Spring Celebrations
- Hindu Calendar
- Festival Dates and Timings
- Team Rankings
- Trending Topics in India
